summary: The PJM Transmission Owners file a partial compliance filing under the June 18 co-location order, adding tariff records that set the Interim NITS rate, and request a July 1, 2028 effective date.
ask: Accept the partial compliance filing without hearing, modification or condition, effective July 1, 2028.

points.point: The filing implements the rate for Interim Network Integration Transmission Service ordered on June 18.
points.quote: the PJM Transmission Owners are submitting new and revised tariff records to the PJM Open Access Transmission Tariff

points.point: The three new services are Interim NITS, firm contract demand and non-firm contract demand transmission service.
points.quote: The new transmission services are: Interim NITS, firm contract demand transmission service, and non-firm contract demand transmission service.

points.point: FERC granted a 90-day extension to November 16, 2026, but PJM committed to file Interim NITS provisions on August 17.
points.quote: Notwithstanding its request for extension, PJM committed to submit a compliance filing on August 17, 2026, addressing several compliance directives, including those related to Interim NITS.

points.point: New Part XI sections 706 and 706.1 set the Interim NITS rate, with two new definitions.
points.quote: New Sections 706 and 706.1 specify the Interim NITS rate.

points.point: The owners request a July 1, 2028 effective date.
points.quote: The PJM Transmission Owners request that the revisions submitted with this partial compliance filing become effective on July 1, 2028.

points.point: They note the directives are under challenge and the tariff sheets may face a termination filing.
points.quote: the tendered tariff sheet revisions herein may be subject to a subsequent termination filing.

throughLine.text: Carries out the E-2 order's new co-location services by filing the Interim NITS rate, ahead of the November 16 date that aligns with PJM's E-7 show cause response.
